items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: Willie Sims who was in our family for almost 40 years looking after my grandmother... Willie Sims really took care of my grandmother but during the day my parents were not around... I really was on my own really and these three wonderful women... were around me giving me lots of love.

ctx.x: I still just play on the white keys.

After a while I started realizing that hey, I don’t have to keep playing the same stuff, I started doing my own stuff. And that same, every time something really happened, you know, that really was a thrill, that thing would go up my back and and I’d say you know that’s good. And there’s nobody in the building except for one person on the third floor of this building that we called — where I was from ages zero to five there was eight boys were living on the eighth floor — day students from Monday through Friday —…
Do you recall the first time, or a significant time when you witnessed segregation or racial attitudes that were mysterious to you?
